articles.title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
articles.description:
“I thought it was because training camp had already started. But in truth it’s because he is judging his girlfriend’s cheerleading competition."

The post Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Adam Vinatieri delivered a humorous Hall-of-Fame speech on August 9, 2026.
He joked about Bill Belichick's absence due to a cheerleading competition.
Vinatieri's remarks highlight ongoing local interest in Patriots' legacy and Deflategate.

articles.title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
articles.description:
The child, who was wearing a helmet, died from their injuries at the scene, officials said.

The post Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: A 7-year-old child was hit and killed by a vehicle while biking.
The incident occurred despite the child wearing a helmet at the time.
Local officials emphasize the need for increased safety measures for cyclists.
